overall: The AG found neither the Board nor the invitation-only group violated the Open Meeting Law: the group was not a public body and the Board members attended without deliberating. Allegations against the Town Administrator were declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board and other officials violated the law by attending an October 30, 2014 informational session open only by invitation, closed to the public.
allegations.key_passage: Because there was no communication between or among a quorum, there was no deliberation and the informational session therefore fell within one of the exceptions to the definition of "meeting"

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the invitation-only session was a meeting; the group was organized by the Town Administrator, an individual official not subject to the law.
allegations.key_passage: Although certain attendees were public officials, we find that this group was not "within government" and therefore was not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Allegations against the Town Administrator individually, who organized the session as an individual public official rather than a public body member.
allegations.key_passage: Mr. Coderre is an individual public official who is not a member of a public body, thus he is not subject to the Open Meeting Law.
